svg.title: At t = 1 the fundamental theorem of calculus identifies this with the square circulation. At t = 0 it is ∂iAj −∂jAi. Homogeneity gives Nij(tx, t) = tkNij(x, 1). If all integer square samples of a sum of components through k vanish, multiply the rescaled component of degree lby tk−l. Choose integer xt with txt →x. The resulting finite sum is zero for t > 0; continuity at zero leaves only N(k) ij (x, 0). Thus the top curl vanishes. Radial reconstruction (RJ4) makes the top potential zero. Descending induction eliminates all components. No interchange of the two iterated integrals in (PF6) is required.
